messages.text: I can read the public work order/period/policy projection but the source ACL restricts supporting records and its attachment to records-custodian. For the read-only review, could an authorized custodian provide the cost event record(s) tied to WO-2025-09-004 / MO-25-09-1070 (including source transaction ID, amount in cents, event-created timestamp, recorded accounting status), and any relevant evidence? No database changes needed.

For my read-only Epic Games, Inc. v. Google LLC et al. Q3 2025 IRM review, the public assessment identifies RSK-EPGGL-2025Q3-CUR. The report receipt is needs_evidence. Could a records-custodian verify the current assessment control selection/results (especially controls with evidence_status Partial and remediation_status Open/In progress), with source evidence/reference? I cannot read the protected supporting-record resources under my assigned-analyst ACL; no changes are needed.

I can read the public task-record excerpt for the Wayfinding Checklist (23 of 45 controls); the remaining 22 appear to be in a protected source that this analyst role cannot access. Could the records custodian or authorized reviewer provide a permitted status/count summary and blocked control IDs/service names, or advise on the approved access path? I will not attempt to read the protected resource without authorization.
